disambiguation: Not a general knowledge base; it is an action tool that uses AI to perform tasks like writing notes, searching, and creating folders within the vault.
extras: The plugin is free, MIT, and has no paid tiers, locked features, or telemetry.
intentEvidence: This one is built the other way round. The phone is the target; the desktop is where you tidy up afterwards.
motivation: Every AI note tool asks you to move your notes somewhere: into Notion's cloud, into a chat window where you paste text back and forth, or onto a desktop-only setup that needs a local CLI, a Node process, or an MCP bridge running in the background.
problem: Existing AI note tools often require cloud services, local processes, or companion apps, making a seamless mobile-first experience difficult.
summary: A voice-first AI agent that uses the DeepSeek API to search the web, read links, and write notes or folders directly into the local Markdown vault on desktop and iPhone.
